# WPMN Design System

> AI-friendly component and section library + CSS design token system for WPManageNinja products (FluentForms, FluentCRM, NinjaTables, and 13 more WordPress plugin brands). Plain CSS custom properties + React + self-contained HTML sections, no build step. 16 brands switch via a single `data-brand` attribute; light/dark via `data-theme`.

This file tells AI agents how to fetch and use this design system.

## How to use this repo as an AI agent

1. Fetch `registry.json` first — it lists every component and section, with files, interactions, tokens used, category/role, and tags.
2. For each item, choose ONE of two paths:
   - **Prompt path**: fetch its `prompt.md` and follow it as an exact build spec (px values, token names, easings, states) to recreate it in any stack.
   - **Code path**: fetch its source (`.jsx` + `.css` for components; a single self-contained `section.html` for sections) and use it as-is.
3. Always load the token CSS first: `index.css` (imports primitives -> brand-primitives -> tokens -> typography in order).
4. Sections are drop-in: one `<section class="wpmn-sec-<id>">` containing scoped styles, markup, and a scoped script. They coexist on one page and re-skin with `data-brand` / `data-theme` on any ancestor.

All files are fetchable via raw URLs: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/master/<path>`

## Core rules (non-negotiable)

- **Tokens only**: semantic tokens (`--color-*`, `--btn-*`, `--input-*`, `--radius-*`, `--font-*`, `--shadow-*`). No raw hex/rgb, no raw font sizes/weights, radii via tokens or calc() over tokens. Tints via `color-mix()` over tokens.
- **Surface pairing**: dark text on light surfaces, `--color-text-*-invert` on dark/brand surfaces. Never dark-on-dark or light-on-light.
- **Buttons** follow `components/Button/Button.css` exactly: primary (brand bg + invert text + `--btn-bg-glow` inset + hovered/pressed/focus-visible states), secondary (transparent + 1.5px brand border, fills on hover; ghost-invert variant on dark surfaces), tertiary (text-only). Size steps 32-64px, radius `--radius-xsm`, 120ms ease states, one primary per section, no pill buttons, no underlines.
- **Icons**: Hugeicons Pro only (`node scripts/extract-hugeicon.mjs <name> stroke.rounded`), ONE unified variant per site (library standard stroke.rounded), 24 viewBox, currentColor, invert color on dark surfaces.
- **Motion**: keyframes prefixed `wpmn-`, everything behind `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Full rules: `wpmn-design-guideline.md`, `docs/`. QA tooling: `scripts/design-qa.mjs`, `scripts/audit-surface-pairing.mjs`.

## Components (9)

- **Badge** (`badge`) — Status badge. Prompt: `components/Badge/prompt.md` · Code: `components/Badge/Badge.jsx` + `components/Badge/Badge.css`
- **Breadcrumbs** (`breadcrumbs`) — Breadcrumb navigation. Prompt: `components/Breadcrumbs/prompt.md` · Code: `components/Breadcrumbs/Breadcrumbs.jsx` + `components/Breadcrumbs/Breadcrumbs.css`
- **Button** (`button`) — Primary action button. Prompt: `components/Button/prompt.md` · Code: `components/Button/Button.jsx` + `components/Button/Button.css`
- **Icons** (`icons`) — Inline SVG icon components extracted from @hugeicons/react-pro v0.3.2. Prompt: `components/Icons/prompt.md` · Code: `components/Icons/HugeIcons.jsx`
- **Input** (`input`) — Text input with label, hint, error/success messaging, left/right icons. Prompt: `components/Input/prompt.md` · Code: `components/Input/Input.jsx` + `components/Input/Input.css`
- **Logo** (`logo`) — Inline SVG brand logo renderer. Prompt: `components/Logo/prompt.md` · Code: `components/Logo/Logo.jsx` + `components/Logo/Logo.css`
- **NavBar** (`navbar`) — Responsive site header. Prompt: `components/NavBar/prompt.md` · Code: `components/NavBar/NavBar.jsx` + `components/NavBar/NavBar.css`
- **SocialIcons** (`socialicons`) — Standalone social icon button group. Prompt: `components/SocialIcons/prompt.md` · Code: `components/SocialIcons/SocialIcons.jsx` + `components/SocialIcons/SocialIcons.css`
- **Text** (`text`) — Polymorphic typography component. Prompt: `components/Text/prompt.md` · Code: `components/Text/Text.jsx` + `typography.css`

## Sections (57)

Each: `sections/<id>/section.html` (code) + `sections/<id>/prompt.md` (build spec) + `sections/<id>/meta.json`.

### Announcement
- **Announcement Bar** (`announcement-bar`) — Slim dark dismissible bar for promos: bold lead-in, arrow link, close button.

### Blog
- **Blog Cards** (`blog-cards`) — 3-column article cards: 16:9 cover, category + read time meta, title, excerpt.
- **Stacked List** (`stacked-list`) — Uniform feed rows: date column, title + excerpt, tag pill.

### CTA
- **Builder CTA Card** (`builder-cta`) — Large CTA card with a brand-tinted gradient, kicker pill, logo-in-heading, two-column icon feature list, paired CTAs, and a product screenshot that fades into the card on the right..
- **CTA Impact Banner** (`cta-banner`) — High-contrast dark panel (surface-secondary, radius 32) with H2, subtext, primary + ghost CTA pair, and a guarantee note.

### Clients
- **Infinite Marquee** (`infinite-marquee`) — Continuous auto-scrolling logo band via duplicated track + translateX keyframes (28s loop).
- **Logo Cloud** (`logo-cloud`) — Trust strip: one-line label + centered flex row of grayscale logos at 65% opacity, full opacity on hover.

### Comparison
- **Competitor Comparison** (`comparison-table`) — Us-vs-them matrix: highlighted Us column, success checks and error crosses, mixed text cells, CTA below..
- **Expandable Table** (`expandable-table`) — Comparison table whose rows expand inline (max-height transition) to reveal a 3-fact detail grid.
- **Product Compare Table** (`product-compare-table`) — 4-product feature matrix with a rounded highlight ring around the hero column, tri-state check/minus/cross marks, and JS-generated stacked cards on mobile..

### Content
- **Collapsible Drawer** (`collapsible-drawer`) — Slide-out side panel over a stage area.
- **Read More** (`read-more`) — Long text truncated at 170px with a bottom fade.

### FAQ
- **FAQ Accordion** (`faq-accordion`) — Centered section header + 800px accordion list.

### Features
- **Animated Feature Grid** (`animated-feature-grid`) — 2x2 illustrated feature cards with living micro-scenes: a signing pen over a binary canvas, a cycling analytics chart, a macbook lid that opens and app icons that fly in, and a live speedometer..
- **Bento Grid** (`bento-grid`) — 4-column bento with span-2 and tall boxes, icon tiles, one inverted dark box with a big stat.
- **Content Accordion** (`content-accordion`) — Two-column disclosure: pinned heading left, numbered single-open accordion right.
- **Feature Tabs** (`content-tabs`) — Centered header + pill tab bar switching content panels.
- **Dark Features Panel** (`dark-features-panel`) — Full-bleed dark rounded panel with a chip header, centered title, and a 3x3 feature grid cut by gradient-fading dividers with masked intersection dots; side rulers frame the panel and a brand spark streak slides down the edge lines on loop..
- **Feature Card Stack** (`feature-card-stack`) — Sticky section heading with dark feature cards that stack over it on scroll; each pinned card scales down to 0.94 as the next slides over (rAF-driven, linear with scroll).
- **Feature Scrollspy** (`feature-scrollspy`) — Sticky scrollspy menu beside a column of feature cards.
- **Feature Tabs Carousel** (`feature-tabs-carousel`) — Auto-advancing tabbed feature panel on a drifting brand gradient.
- **Fibonacci Bento** (`fibonacci-bento`) — Framed media bento on a Fibonacci-style 5-card grid.
- **Multi-Column Cards** (`multi-column-cards`) — Classic 3-column feature cards (guideline grid #3, 32px gutter): icon tile, heading, body.
- **Sticky Feature Switcher** (`sticky-feature-switcher`) — Pinned two-panel scroll story.
- **Sticky Side-by-Side** (`sticky-scroll`) — 5/7 split where the left heading pins (sticky top 96px) while feature cards scroll on the right..
- **Zig-Zag Features** (`zigzag-features`) — Alternating image/text rows (even rows flip order).

### Footer
- **Footer** (`footer`) — Full site footer.
- **Mega Footer** (`mega-footer`) — Full mega footer: white card over a soft stage with a 3-column grid (heading + CTAs + community icons, link groups, newsletter form + social row), a giant outline gradient wordmark, and a copyright row..

### Hero
- **Agency Hero** (`agency-hero`) — Agency-style hero: outline badge, oversized two-line heading beside an intro + pill CTA, then a media row pairing a large team photo (with a spinning circular contact badge) with a growth chart card and a dark stat card..
- **Board Hero** (`board-hero`) — Dark product hero: pulsing brand badge, display headline with a highlighted word, intro and CTA pair over a perspective-tilted browser window holding a live-looking kanban board (three columns, tags, progress bars, avatars) with floating stat tiles, a dot grid and ambient brand glows..
- **Ecommerce Hero** (`ecommerce-hero`) — Commerce hero: brand-dash eyebrow, display heading with a hand-drawn underline, intro and primary CTA beside a floating dashboard collage (product card with sizes and Add to Cart, sales/orders stat cards with count-ups, brand gauge card, in-stock tag) over a tilted soft stage, plus a muted logo band..
- **Standard Hero** (`hero-standard`) — Page-opening hero: dot badge, H1 with brand accent, subtext, paired CTAs, 16:9 mockup inside a brand-surface container (radius 32, mockup radius 16 + soft shadow)..
- **Typographic Hero** (`hero-typographic`) — Minimalist hero built on massive type: clamp(48px, 8vw, 96px) bold headline with brand accent span, subtext, paired CTAs.
- **Notch Tabs Hero** (`notch-tabs-hero`) — Centered hero with a white notched tab bar (inverse-corner radial-gradient shoulders) overlapping a brand gradient showcase; switching tabs blurs the screenshot out (scale .949, 15px drop, 4px blur over 250ms) and springs the next one back in..
- **Portrait Stats Hero** (`portrait-stats-hero`) — Split hero: outline badge, display heading, intro, paired CTAs and a trusted-by logo row on the left; a portrait photo card with a radial brand glow and two floating stat tiles (count-up number + delta, rating with star) on the right..

### How It Works
- **Horizontal Scroll** (`horizontal-scroll`) — 300vh tall wrapper pins a viewport; vertical scroll progress translates a horizontal panel track.
- **Stacking Cards** (`stacking-cards`) — Cards pin with position:sticky at stepped offsets and stack as the page scrolls.
- **Steps Card Stack** (`steps-card-stack`) — Four full-viewport gradient step cards pin with position:sticky and squash away (scale to 0.70, rotateX to 27deg, per-card rotateZ tilt, late opacity fade) over a 942px pin while the next card slides over..
- **Steps Walkthrough** (`steps-walkthrough`) — 4 numbered cards with connecting arrows.

### Integrations
- **Integration Grid** (`integration-grid`) — 4-column app tiles: logo tile, name, one-line purpose.

### Newsletter
- **Newsletter Signup** (`newsletter-signup`) — Bordered 32px-radius panel, icon tile, heading, single email input + subscribe button, privacy note.
- **Split Screen 50/50** (`split-screen`) — Even two-column split: brand-surface visual left, badge + heading + inline email capture right.

### Pricing
- **Pricing Table** (`pricing-table`) — 3 tiers with a Most Popular highlight (2px brand border + shadow), monthly/yearly toggle swapping prices via data attributes, check-listed features..
- **Pricing Toggle** (`pricing-toggle`) — Three-plan pricing with a sliding monthly/yearly toggle, a dark featured plan, dashed dividers, icon feature lists, and a full-width enterprise row.

### Roadmap
- **Timeline Roadmap** (`timeline-roadmap`) — Vertical axis with status dots: done (success check), in progress (brand pulse dot), planned (empty).

### Showcase
- **Asymmetric Grid** (`asymmetric-grid`) — 12-column broken grid with intentional vertical offsets for an editorial feel.
- **Before/After Slider** (`before-after-slider`) — Draggable divider over two stacked panels using clip-path inset, pointer events, 16:9 frame with knob handle..
- **Carousel Slider** (`carousel-slider`) — Scroll-snap horizontal belt, 3-up responsive, arrow buttons, auto-generated page dots that track scroll position..
- **Masonry Grid** (`masonry-grid`) — Pinterest-style packing via CSS columns (3/2/1 responsive).
- **Mockup Showcase** (`mockup-showcase`) — Browser-framed screenshot (chrome dots + URL bar) on a dark surface stage, following the guideline mockup rules: 16px frame radius, soft-500 shadow, 32px stage radius..
- **Product Showcase** (`product-showcase`) — E-commerce best picks grid: large featured product card spanning two rows + 2x2 grid of smaller cards.
- **Work Portfolio Shade** (`work-portfolio`) — Pinned window-shade portfolio: project rows collapse from full height to a thin strip sequentially as the page scrolls (1000px of scroll per item), with image hover zoom, an ink counter pill, and a See More button with text-slide + corner-arrow hover.

### Stats
- **Stat Counter Grid** (`stats-counter`) — 4-column metric grid with large brand-colored numbers that count up when scrolled into view.

### Team
- **Team Grid** (`team-grid`) — 4-column people cards: circular avatar, name, role, social icon links.

### Testimonial
- **Folder Quote Cards** (`folder-quote-cards`) — Three case-study quote cards drawn as folder tabs (stretched SVG outline with a top notch).
- **Quote Stats Bento** (`quote-stats-bento`) — Social proof bento: four stat cards (grey shell, white inset panel) interleaved with two brand-tinted quote cards carrying a fading dot pattern, company name, quote, and author line..
- **Testimonial Grid** (`testimonial-grid`) — Wall-of-love masonry (CSS columns) of quote cards with star rows, avatar initials, names and roles..
